Dominant color family: pink-violet family: rose pink #E88BB0, soft violet #9B6FD0, deep purple #5A4A8A. Background: a gradient field of rose-pink blending into soft violet-blue with gentle ripples and drifting petal-like shards. Personality read: prickly outside, warm inside. Centered composition, plain abstract layered background, single figure only. 16-bit pixel art adjacent abstract, layered color strata style, flat wide color blocks arranged in horizontal strata, subtle pixel texture grain, clean high-readability silhouettes, cinematic lighting, no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
